. स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रम के लिए कोचिंग के लिए छात्र को स्नातक के अंतिम वर्ष तक या स्नातक परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने के अगले वर्ष तक कोचिंग की सुविधा दी जाएगी। 12 . कोचिंग संस्था में प्रवेशित छात्र कोचिंग संस्थान के साथ हुए अनुबंध की अवधि में ही कोर्स पूरा कर सके| यदि किसी संस्था से अनुबंध 2 वर्ष की अवधि के लिए किया गया है तो अनुबंध के प्रथम वर्ष में 02 वर्षीय पाठयक्रम में प्रवेश लिया जा सकता है किन्तु द्वितीय वर्ष में 02 वर्षीय पाठयक्रम में प्रवेश नहीं लिया जा सकता है |

IIT और मेडिकल में प्रवेश लेने के इच्छुक अनुसूचित जनजाति के आवेदक को कक्षा 10वीं में गणित और विज्ञान विषय में 70 % अंक प्राप्त करने की आवश्यकता है। 5. स्नातक स्तर के छात्रों को स्नातक के दूसरे और तीसरे वर्ष में 60% अंक प्राप्त होने चाहिए | यदि परीक्षा परिणाम पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में घोषित नहीं किए जाते हैं तो परीक्षा परिणाम पर विचार किया जाएगा। 06. आवेदक राष्ट्रीय स्तर के तकनीकी/चिकित्सा/विधि पाठ्यक्रमों में प्रवेश हेतु कोचिंग हेतु कक्षा 11 एवं 12 में नियमित रूप से अध्ययनरत होना चाहिए। 07
. आवेदक सामाजिक न्याय एवं अधिकारिता विभाग के जयपुर एवं कोटा के छात्रावासों में निवास करें। 08. आवेदक राष्ट्र स्तरीय प्रबंधन शिक्षण संस्थानों तथा (आईआईएम) इत्यादि में प्रवेश के लिए कैट / मैट की कोचिंग के लिए स्नातक / स्नातकोत्तर में राजकीय अथवा मान्यता प्राप्त निजी महाविधयालय में नियमित रूप से अध्ययनरत हो | 09. परिवार की वार्षिक आय (सभी स्रोत) से रुपये 2.50 लाख से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए | 10. छात्रों को इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल कोर्स की प्रवेश परीक्षाओं के लिए अधिकतम दो साल की अवधि के लिए और लॉ एंड मैनेजमेंट कोर्स की प्रवेश परीक्षाओं के लिए केवल एक साल के लिए कोचिंग की सुविधा उपलब्ध होगी। 11
. स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रम के लिए कोचिंग के लिए छात्र को स्नातक के अंतिम वर्ष तक या स्नातक परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने के अगले वर्ष तक कोचिंग की सुविधा दी जाएगी। 12 . कोचिंग संस्था में प्रवेशित छात्र कोचिंग संस्थान के साथ हुए अनुबंध की अवधि में ही कोर्स पूरा कर सके| यदि किसी संस्था से अनुबंध 2 वर्ष की अवधि के लिए किया गया है तो अनुबंध के प्रथम वर्ष में 02 वर्षीय पाठयक्रम में प्रवेश लिया जा सकता है किन्तु द्वितीय वर्ष में 02 वर्षीय पाठयक्रम में प्रवेश नहीं लिया जा सकता है |

schemes.original_eligibility_text:
Students who have passed Class 12th with a minimum of 65% marks from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education and a minimum of 75% marks from the Central Board of Secondary Education, and are studying in any school in Rajasthan.
Regular students in Class 12th in government (including residential schools run by the state government) and private schools who have achieved the prescribed percentage of marks in the scheme run by the concerned department. Marks obtained in the supplementary examination will not be included in the prescribed percentage marks.
Students who are studying as regular students in a graduate degree from any college in Rajasthan (such as B.A.BED / B.SC.BED / B.COM.BED / BE / B.TECH / B.ARCH / MBBS / IIT / BBA / BBM / BCA / BDS / BHMS / BAMS / LAW, etc.).
The benefit of the scheme will not be given if there is a gap of one year from the year of passing Class 12th to the admission in the graduate degree.
Students receiving financial assistance from any other scheme will also be benefited from this scheme. Students receiving financial assistance/scholarship from any other scheme will not be deprived of this scheme.
Students who have received the benefit of a scooter in any scheme of the state government based on their marks in any class prior to the implementation of this scheme are not eligible to receive a scooter under this scheme. However, if a student has received a scooter based on the result of Class 10th from the TAD department or the school education department prior to this scheme, then that student will receive a lump sum amount of ?40,000 based on the result of Class 12th if eligible.
Under the Devnarayan Scheme and Kali Bai Bhil Meritorious Girl Scooty Scheme, the annual income limit of the beneficiary student parents will be 2.5 lakh rupees.
The scheme operated by the T&D Department will provide benefits to all eligible students from families exempt from income tax.

Students who pursue their studies through correspondence courses will be eligible.
All Children of the same parents/gurdians will be entitled to receive benefits of the scheme.

Scholarship holders who are receiving coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers will not be eligible."

schemes.original_eligibility_text:
1 The first 6000 students studying in government schools of Rajasthan, who have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 8 Primary Education Eligibility Examination, as per the state-level merit list, and the first 100 students studying in government schools in each district, who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks in the Class 8 Primary Education Eligibility Examination, as per the district-level merit list, will be eligible to receive the benefits of the scheme.
2 The first 5880 students who have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 10 Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education Examination, as per the state-level merit list, and the first 120 students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Praveshika Examination, will be eligible for the scheme. Similarly, at the district level, the first 98 students studying in government schools, who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks in the Class 10 Board Examination as per the district-level merit list, and the first two students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Praveshika Examination, will be eligible to receive the benefits of the scheme.
The number of eligible students at the state and district levels will be as follows:
a. State Level:
The first 5880 students in the Class 10 merit list.
The first 120 students in the Praveshika Examination merit list.
b. District Level:
The first 98 students in Class 10.
The first two students in the Praveshika Examination.
3 The first 5880 students from all streams studying in government schools of Rajasthan, who have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 12 Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education Examination, as per the state-level merit list, and the first 120 students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Upadhyay Examination, will be eligible for the scheme
. Similarly, at the district level, the first 98 students from all streams studying in government schools, who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks in the Class 12 Board Examination, as per the district-level merit list, and the first two students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Upadhyay Examination, will be eligible to receive the benefits of the scheme.

Scheme will be applicable only for one of the spouse of the registered beneficiary at a time.
Under the scheme, it is necessary to approve the loan taken by the construction workers from the bank/financial institution up to a maximum of Rs 5 lakh for their own business work like buying machines etc.
Under the scheme assistance, loan amount taken for purchase of shop / plot / vehicle or household items is not payable.
The annual interest payable on business loan taken up to Rs. 5 lakh will be reimbursed only if the beneficiary submits a certificate of intent to pay interest annually to the financial institution.
Non-payment of interest by the beneficiary within the stipulated time or by the financial institution On imposition of penalty / penalty, the reimbursement of the fine amount will not be done by the Board.
During scrutiny of application and documents, if any facts found to be false resulting in the cancellation of eligibility, it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit all the assistance amount sanctioned under the scheme along with interest.

schemes.original_eligibility_text:
Construction workers who are registered as beneficiaries with the board and are consistently making contributions will be eligible for this scheme.
The beneficiary son/daughter must have passed the entrance examination of IIT or IIM and secured admission as a regular student in a listed educational institution.
The tuition fees for the listed educational institution must have been paid by the beneficiary.
The total annual income of the candidate parents from all sources should not exceed 2.50 lakh rupees.
If any information provided in the assistance application under the scheme is found to be false, the beneficiary concerned will be responsible for repaying the entire approved assistance amount along with interest in a lump sum.

schemes.original_eligibility_text:
Rules for vidhawa punarvivah
The applicant woman is a native of Rajasthan state or has been residing in Rajasthan for a period of three years from the date of remarriage.
The applicant woman is a widow or is leading a virtuous life.
If the applicant woman has not remarried before the implementation of the scheme, then she is eligible for the scheme.
The age of the applicant widow should be between 18-50 years.
The applicant woman should be eligible for Widow Pension.
No other member of the family of the widowed woman should be twenty or more than twenty years of age.
